filename.title_pattern_note: New notes are titled 'YYYY-MM Title.md': month stamp, then a short title. Daily journals, indices and templates keep their own convention.

frontmatter.note: Off by default. Add a key only when a Dataview query or a template needs it; do not stamp created/updated on every note, since the title carries the month.

footer.note: New notes end with the vault's Note template footer: a #### line, a --- rule, then Status/Tags/Links/References.

tags.note: 95% of existing tag wikilinks resolve (1273/1343); the rest are aspirational index notes. Style is enforced, existence is a warning.

legacy.note: Notes created before the standard are reported, never rewritten automatically.

prose.note: Keep prose minimal: headings and bullets carry the structure, a paragraph only when a list would lose the reasoning.

no_manual_wrap.note: A paragraph or list item is one physical line. Breaks are only for real structure.

scaffold.note: obsidian-lint --new builds this shape from the vault template: H1, section bullets, template footer, no frontmatter.

images.note: Photos go into the vault with a short, meaningful name and embed at a set width. 63 vault images live at the root today, so the default folder is the root; empty folder means root.

markers.meaning: LLM-generated content that adds to the note and to the bullet it sits under. The owner also types it as feedback or a command for the next pass, like TODOCLAUDE.
LLM-generated status or feedback: meta information, not topic content, e.g. 'could not find images for this item'.

callouts.note: List callouts rendered by the List Callouts plugin (both mapped there). Written '- <char> text'. The model never deletes either marker.
